arguments.body:
Added the new pure `src/decision` package (`src/decision/commands.ts`, `src/decision/derive.ts`, `src/decision/ids.ts`, `src/decision/snapshot.ts`) along with its test suite (`tests/decision/derive.test.ts` and `tests/decision/snapshot-builder.ts`).

### Verification & Findings
- `tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json` passes cleanly and `bun test` passes all 115 tests across 13 test files.
- However, the overall repository migration to replace the old materialization/decision layer with `src/decision` is **incomplete**: no teammate session logs or changes were applied to the workspace, so the legacy files and types (`src/runtime/run-materialization.ts`, `src/compiler/select-unit-inputs.ts`, `src/compiler/materialize-stage.ts`, `src/compiler/materialize-units.ts`, `src/domain/run-decisions.ts`, `RunDecision` in `src/domain/run-record.ts` / `src/storage/repositories.ts`, and their legacy tests `tests/run-decisions.test.ts`, `tests/materialize-stage.test.ts`, `tests/materialize-units.test.ts`, `tests/dev-flow-stage-contracts.test.ts`) are still present and have not been migrated or removed because the specification for the storage/runtime/compiler consumer changes was not provided to this agent.
